summary: Frontend-only verification (A/B/D/E) of 'Ultimo acquisto' states in AI Tour Live and GPTour as roberto.beretta. Live Tour: next-visit shows aitour-next-last-order with -empty; pending list has 25 base rows (18 -empty + 7 ready triplets date/download/number + 0 loading + 0 error); first-pending detail shows aitour-detail-last-order with -empty. Click on one -download triggered window.print() exactly 1 time and no -download-error nor console errors. GPTour: single chat turn 'Tabaccherie di Segrate che non comprano da 30 giorni' produced thinking stages ('Interpreto la richiesta…' -> 'Preparo il giro con i punti verificati…'), gptour-purchase-filter text exactly 'Ultimo acquisto da almeno 30 giorni · Clienti e orfani con storico acquisti · Segrate', plan with 1 tappa (Bar Tabacchi di Rausa Giuseppe, Segrate), gptour-last-order-* present with 'Ultimo ordine: 10/07/2026 (91 giorni fa)' and 'Ordine ORD-20260710-123409-R8SXMB', assistant line exactly 'Ho proposto 1 tappa tra 1 clienti e orfani idonei nel comune di Segrate, con ultimo acquisto risalente ad almeno 30 giorni.'. Scope C (saved tours tab) skipped by design because Live Tour is active. No white screens, no Metro red box. Zero CRM writes performed.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web hydration warning: <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. gptour-last-order-* Pressable is nested inside gptour-stop-0 Pressable, so on web both become <button role="button">, which is invalid HTML and raises a hydration warning in console. Functionality works but should be restructured (make the inner element a non-focusable View with onPress on an inner Pressable sibling, or stop rendering the outer stop as Pressable when a nested Pressable is present). Reference: GPTour plan rendering of gptour-stop-0 / gptour-last-order-* (see components/aitour/gptour/Plan.tsx).

action_items: Resolve nested Pressable in GPTour Plan: gptour-last-order-* currently renders as a <button> inside the gptour-stop-* <button>, producing a React Native Web hydration warning. Suggested fix: do not wrap the whole stop row in Pressable, or move the last-order button outside the row Pressable, so the <button> nesting disappears on web.

Optional: confirm whether the GPTour thinking-stage pipeline is expected to show the 'Verifico gli ultimi acquisti…' intermediate label; in this run only two stages appeared ('Interpreto la richiesta…' -> 'Preparo il giro con i punti verificati…'), likely because the 30g filter path collapses the two stages when the cached pool is already loaded.

window.print integration from Pressable (-download) works via expo-print on web preview; no -download-error triggered, no exceptions.
GPTour purchase-filter and plan message strings exactly match the web-repo parity spec (singular/plural respected: '1 tappa tra 1 clienti e orfani idonei nel comune di Segrate').

rca_of_issue: Nested Pressable warning RCA: on web, Pressable renders as HTML <button role=button>. In GPTour Plan each stop row is itself a Pressable (gptour-stop-N), and inside that row the LastOrderInfo renders a second Pressable for the order link (gptour-last-order-*-...), producing <button> inside <button>. React logs an HTML spec violation (hydration warning). Reproduction: open /gptour, send 'Tabaccherie di Segrate che non comprano da 30 giorni', wait for plan render, observe console. Mitigation: either remove the outer stop Pressable (expose onPress at a leaf child) or render the last-order action as a plain View+onClick/handler that does not emit a <button>.
